Frequently asked questions

Is FrigAirco really available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week?

Yes. For fridge, cold room and air conditioning repair we can be reached day and night, including weekends and public holidays.

Which areas do you cover?

Wallonia, Brussels and Flanders: Hainaut, Walloon Brabant, Liège, Namur, Luxembourg province, Antwerp, Ghent, Leuven, Mechelen, Hasselt, Kortrijk and their surroundings.

Which equipment do you work on?

Cold rooms and freezer rooms, freezers, commercial fridges, bar fridges and counter fridges, bakery and butcher counters, refrigerated displays, chest freezers, blast chillers, chillers, air conditioning and heat pumps.

Do you also work for homeowners?

Yes. We install, maintain and repair air conditioning and heat pumps in private homes, alongside commercial and industrial refrigeration for businesses.

Are your technicians certified?

Yes. Our engineers are F-Gas certified for handling refrigerants and the company is an approved refrigeration company.

How do I get a quote?

Fill in the contact form, call us or message us on WhatsApp describing what you need. We get back to you quickly.
